endpoints.description: Validate OpenAPI 3.x spec — structural errors, missing fields, schema violations
Lint for best practices — missing descriptions, operationIds, examples, response schemas
Score spec quality — completeness, agent-callability, MCP compatibility, doc coverage
Diff two OpenAPI specs — breaking changes, additions, removals
Execution readiness check with next API chaining
ONE-CALL: validate + lint + score in one shot
